placement.claim: The human-interaction and lifecycle-authority clarification belongs with the existing semantic context-lifecycle contract; host transition orchestration consumes it without acquiring domain authority. This packet preserves the candidate delta without editing the owner-held lifecycle design or accepting a new lifecycle mechanism.
